notes.title: Demo 0.7.2 Update
notes.content:
This update has improved the quality of life and fixed some bugs

Looking forward to the release of the game


The game title has become more high-definition
The initial scene of the game has been remaked
Add the function of skipping conversations with the ctrl key
Buttons will be displayed in the interact prompt
Optimization of quest delivery page
The display of the door is more obvious
Larger font for tutorial guidance
Dialogue options can be selected through the keyboard
The NPC of the plot task will display the avatar on the map
When viewing a solution from bookmark, clicking Close can directly close the encyclopedia instead of returning to the upper menu
Increase the maximum basic focus (100 → 150)
Avril facility quest can increase in the limit of focus (10 → 25)
Bug fix: Stuck after close the load menu in the Nuby story
Bug fix: Some properties in the solution property map are not displayed
